shortDescription: Brian Armstrong said on X that users do not need to sell Bitcoin to use it as collateral for a home down payment and can continue holding Bitcoin exposure. According to Odaily, he made the remarks in a post on the social media platform X.

title: Brian Armstrong Says Bitcoin Can Be Used as Mortgage Collateral for Home Down Payments
